dedupe_keys.name: miraca pan european critical infrastructure exposure database deliverable d1 4

description: This database is the harmonised pan-European exposure dataset of critical infrastructure assets built in the MIRACA project (Multi-hazard Infrastructure Risk Assessment for Climate Adaptation). It covers 35 European countries and ten infrastructure networks: roads, railways, airports, ports, education, healthcare, telecom, power, gas and oil, and was built with an automated geospatial workflow that uses OpenStreetMap as its primary source. The deliverable was prepared by Paraskevi Tsoumani, Stavroula Fotopoulou, Stella Karafagka, Anna Karatzetzou and Dimitris Pitilakis of Aristotle University of Thessaloniki and Elco Koks of VU Amsterdam; MIRACA is funded by Horizon Europe and its partners include VU Amsterdam, Deltares, the University of Oxford, the University of Ljubljana, Vizzuality and Lobelia. Version 1 of 27 April 2026 is accessible on Zenodo as free downloads (a 6.7 GB zip of exposure files and the Jupyter notebook of the workflow) under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: completeness follows OpenStreetMap mapping, which varies by country and asset type, OSM-derived content also carries the ODbL, and asset attributes needed for fragility are limited to what OSM tags. It supports multi-hazard exposure and cascading failure simulation of European infrastructure for climate adaptation; related records are GIRI and the ECFAS coastal exposure dataset.
